title: Libre 2 NFC scan
symptom: xDrip cannot scan Libre 2 with NFC and cannot retrieve history from patched LibreLink app, causing gaps in xDrip and Nightscout graphs when phone loses connection with sensor.
cause: Libre 2 data is encrypted and keys are not known, preventing direct NFC scan. Also, xDrip+ does not implement reception of the patched LibreLink intent 'com.librelink.app.ThirdPartyIntegration.SENSOR_SCAN' which contains scanned values.
fix: For Libre 2 EU, NFC scan is supported in xDrip+ (might require OOP2). For filling gaps from patched LibreLink, xDrip+ should implement receiving the intent 'com.librelink.app.ThirdPartyIntegration.SENSOR_SCAN' and handle scanned data, but this is not yet implemented.
evidence_quote: The patched LibreLink sends also an Intent "com.librelink.app.ThirdPartyIntegration.SENSOR_SCAN" with all the scanned values (historic and realtime). I tried it in a small test app and all the scanned values seem to be there. It's just xDrip+, which doesn't take this intent and fills the gap with the scanned values. Couldn't xDrip+ implement the reception of this patched LibreLink intent?
